english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for visually looking at or seeing something, and for examining something briefly.
This is the all-purpose verb for trying to see or looking at someone or something.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for looking at or paying attention to something.
Use 睇 as the all-purpose spoken verb for looking at or watching something.
Use this as the all-purpose visual verb when context or an adverb such as 仔細 makes clear whether the looking is close or quick.
